branchPolicy.principle: Support many software languages through governed roles, not dependency bloat.
branchPolicy.promotionRule: A language can move from reference to runtime only after a small contract, quality check, and rollback note exist.

languages.label: HTML
languages.role: semantic public structure, accessibility landmarks, SEO metadata

languages.label: CSS
languages.role: responsive layout, calm visual system, reduced-motion behavior

languages.label: JavaScript
languages.role: progressive enhancement, interaction safety, static UX behavior

languages.label: TypeScript
languages.role: Next.js UX foundation, typed UI architecture, content contracts

languages.label: Node.js
languages.role: dependency-light local API runtime and quality scripts

languages.label: PHP
languages.role: static-host contact fallback and shared hosting compatibility

languages.label: Python
languages.role: future content tooling, archive analysis, data preparation

languages.label: Java
languages.role: future enterprise integration reference lane

languages.label: C++
